name: Instant cache
tagline: Browser cache: seen pages paint at once
summary: Pages you have opened before appear at once from a cache in your browser, then refresh quietly. Loading skeletons only show for data you have never seen.

flow.label: Boot restore
flow.note: Before hydration, loads the newest 4 MB of cached queries, waiting at most 400 ms.

flow.label: IndexedDB query cache
flow.note: One database per user, one record per query, 50 MB budget, 7-day max age.

flow.label: Route loader
flow.note: Starts a prefetch without awaiting it, so navigation never blocks on data.

flow.label: Stale-time tiers
flow.note: Cached data renders first; anything past its stale time refetches in the background.

flow.label: Route pending skeleton
flow.note: On a hard load the server sends the page's own cold layout; later waits show after 300 ms.

flow.label: Throttled save
flow.note: Writes changed queries to IndexedDB once a second and when the tab is hidden.

features.name: Per-user IndexedDB cache
features.summary: Each account gets its own database: 50 MB, oldest data evicted first, 7-day max age. It is wiped on sign-out or when the session check fails.

features.name: Restore before first paint
features.summary: The newest 4 MB of queries load before React hydrates, capped at 400 ms. The rest loads in pages once the browser is idle.

features.name: Stale times and polling
features.summary: Each kind of data has a stale time (details 5 s, lists 30 s, viewer 5 min). PR status and workflow runs poll every 10 s while CI is running.

features.name: What is not persisted
features.summary: Diffs, file contents, logs and per-keystroke search stay in memory because they are large or short-lived. Webhook settings too, as URLs can embed tokens.

features.name: Preload on intent
features.summary: Hovering or focusing a link preloads its route and data. Pull request rows and workflow run rows preload their detail page once per row.

features.name: Route skeletons
features.summary: A route waits 300 ms before showing a skeleton and keeps it at least 200 ms. On a hard load the server sends the page's own cold layout instead.

features.name: Raw diff cache
features.summary: Raw pull request diffs sit in a second IndexedDB store keyed by revision, so a reopened diff needs no network. 40 MB, 7 days.

issues.note: Predates the cache rebuild (#193, #206). Worth re-testing before it stays open.
